summary.text: Michele Guyton is a Democratic member of the Maryland House of Delegates from District 42B who was first elected in 2018 and has served since January 9, 2019, and she is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A developmental psychologist and former Maryland State Board of Education member, she is vice chair of the Environment and Transportation Committee.

paragraphs.text: Michele Guyton was born in Madison, Tennessee, on October 19, 1966, and earned a B.A. in psychology and anthropology from Vanderbilt University in 1989, according to her General Assembly biography.
She earned an M.A. in 1992 and a Ph.D. in developmental and social psychology in 1996 from Brandeis University.

She was a post-doctoral researcher and adjunct assistant professor at the University of Iowa, developed programs for at-risk families at the Iowa City Domestic Violence Center, and later worked as an educational consultant in Durham County, North Carolina.

Guyton served on the Maryland State Board of Education from 2015 to 2019, where she chaired its Mental Health Committee, and has been a member of the board of the Kennedy Krieger Institute since 2020.
In the House she served on the Ways and Means Committee from 2019 to 2023 and has been a member of the Environment and Transportation Committee since 2023, serving as vice chair in 2026.
Ballotpedia reports that she advanced from the June 23, 2026 Democratic primary.
